intent.raw: author a parallel architecture, specification, experiment program, and plan for formalizing DomainSpec v2 UI meta-types
intent.objective: Produce candidate-only, experiment-backed formation evidence for all 11 UI labels and an authority-safe owner handoff without promoting DS-D1 or mutating DS-D8.

subagent_strategy.trigger: W1 and survivor authoring contain disjoint per-type evidence paths, and W2 benefits from an independent adversarial review.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Parallel workers can investigate separate UI label families after the shared E0 protocol is frozen; shared validator mutation remains serialized.

roles.purpose: Run one disjoint UI label experiment lane under the frozen protocol.
roles.owns: Exactly one of SWU-UIF-004, SWU-UIF-005, or SWU-UIF-006.

roles.purpose: Draft one adjudicated survivor's candidate card, schema, fixtures, and tests.
roles.owns: One disjoint candidate type path within SWU-UIF-008.

roles.purpose: Attack vacuity, collapse, framework bias, counterexamples, and authority leakage in replicated survivor evidence.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Approve runtime subagents only after E0 passes, with one assigned SWU or disjoint candidate path and the receipt contract from WORK-PACK.md.

boundaries.contract: Task Session executes one selected SWU and returns a receipt before work-pack state changes.
Experiment and candidate-schema evidence cannot directly write DS-D1 authority or promotion status.
Active signatures may support exercised graph evidence but raw endpoint use or edge-set inequality cannot prove node formation.

boundaries.to_owner: public structural experiment and validator surface
boundaries.contract: Criteria remain bounded structural predicates and never import private derivation rules or semantic execution.

state_namespaces.write_policy: One selected SWU writes only its declared development paths.
Read-only to this dispatch; changes require a separate owner route.
Serialized under SWU-UIF-009 after survivor adjudication.

steps.name: Author Invoke package
stop_conditions: block if no experiment-first SWU exists or package claims authority

steps.name: Prove experiment method with counterbalanced E0
steps.evidence_artifact: E0 result records for Form/Component and Adapter/Mapping
stop_conditions: block W1 if one frozen protocol cannot represent repeatable survival and collapse outcomes

steps.name: Run all-label experiment lanes
steps.evidence_artifact: terminal receipts for composition, data-interaction, and integration-control lanes
stop_conditions: block join if a lane changes protocol version, overlaps write scopes, or lacks terminal receipt

steps.name: Adjudicate provisional outcomes
stop_conditions: block if any label is missing, duplicated, or described as promoted

steps.name: Draft complete candidate twins for survivors
stop_conditions: block a type if it lacks malformed and neighbor fixtures or crosses the private boundary

steps.name: Serialize validator and instance hardening

outputs.ref: total rule map and candidate instance results

stop_conditions: block unknown rule kinds, semantic inference, or non-discriminating mutations

steps.name: Replicate and adversarially review survivors

outputs.ref: replication and accepted adversarial review packet

stop_conditions: block promotion-ready status when portability, real-corpus evidence, or review coverage is incomplete

steps.name: Assemble owner packet and verify recomposition

inputs.ref: replication and accepted adversarial review packet

stop_conditions: block if candidate evidence is presented as DS-D1 or DS-D8 authority

gates.condition: E0 passes under one frozen protocol before W1 fan-out.
All 11 labels have terminal, schema-valid result records before adjudication.
Only adjudicated survivors receive candidate twins and every twin has complete fixtures, correction, tests, and round trip.
No experiment or candidate artifact changes canonical authority without a separate owner decision.

promotion_guardrails: Experimental survival is not DS-D1 promotion.
DS-D8 endpoint use is not UI node formation authority.
Candidate schemas remain development artifacts until definitions-governance approves them.
Synthetic fixtures alone cannot support promotion-ready status.
Public structural validators do not import private derivation behavior.
